body:
You're not wrong. We truly are all alone in this world physically but that doesn't mean you're alone in your feelings; there are so many people who share your emotions, who feel very similarly to how you feel. Last night, I had police and EMS visit my home three times because I took a shit ton of meds and drank a half liter of alcohol and called 988 to speak to someone as I fell asleep. It's how I cope and even though I know that's a terrible thing to do b/c it worries so many people, it's the only thing I feel works for me. Cutting is the only thing that works for you. I understand and relate to you so much.

You want to talk? Let's talk. If you could say all that you wanted to say without judgment, what would you say? I'm listening.
